line: Wind, dry leaves and a low eerie tone, very quiet, an ambience that loops
why: the cue's own take 2 is the wind and its take 1 the dry leaves; one made low tone that wavers slowly lies under them, quiet support; the wind is measured after the ambience chain's low cut at 70 Hz, because 62 percent of its energy lies under 60 Hz and would make the tone's 12 dB a smaller step than it reads
